query: Build a production-grade API skill for subscription changes and signed event callbacks, with safe verification and behavioral evals.
Our existing deployment CLI skill documents options that changed. Harden it against current version and help output and add release tests.
We renamed one installable skill and now the catalog, registry, router, and dependents disagree. Reconcile the library.

This agent guidance handles both autonomous review and an explicit release command. Decide whether those jobs should be discoverable together, explicitly invoked, or split into independently reached packages.
Our agent loads a 3,000-line multi-domain reference for every question. Reorganize the installable guidance so each request reaches only the relevant topic without losing shared rules.
The draft under our experimental agent-guidance lane is supposed to move into the stable collection. Gate the promotion on placeholders, evals, wrappers, registry entries, and fresh discovery.
Audit this installable agent package: it still has unresolved draft markers, an empty eval suite, duplicate wrapper instructions, and claims verification passed.
Figure out the correct repo-local destination for a new production agent capability, scaffold the installable package there, and prove a fresh installer can discover it.
These two installed agent packages compete for the same request and follow the same workflow. Decide whether to merge, compose, or keep them separate, then reconcile their routes.
Create a deployment CLI skill, but verify it without performing an unauthorized production write or sending notifications.

Old-lint is still active in our catalog even though code-review replaced it. Migrate every dependent, move the old package to the repository's retired state, and remove active routes without erasing required migration history.
The retired legacy notifier has exceeded our retention window and a dependency scan is empty. Remove the package and reconcile catalog, registry, router, installer, and discovery output.
Make a tiny personal hello-world skill; it is a disposable one-liner and needs no production workflow.
Review this typed function for readability and refactor the nested conditionals.
Write maintainable unit tests for this billing service and improve the fixtures.
Tighten the prose in our repository README without changing any agent skill behavior.
Install an existing database skill into my current agent's global skills folder.
Build an MCP server that exposes our inventory API to agents.
What installed skills are available for working with embedded databases?
Organize our architecture decision records and write an index for the documentation folder.
Use the repository CLI to list my open change requests and filter them by author.
Write a reusable system prompt for a customer-support chatbot; do not package it as an installable skill.
Deprecate the `legacyMode` method in our application SDK and add a compiler warning; this is ordinary product code, not agent guidance.
Delete the retired-notifier source module from this application after its imports are gone; there are no agent packages, catalogs, or discovery surfaces involved.
